summary: Modules use the Native String strategy: bare string literals are bytes on Python 2 and text on Python 3, and modules should expect those types.
questions: What string strategy do modules use?

answer_card.title: Module string strategy: native strings
answer_card.answer_md: Modules use **native strings**: the type of a bare literal like `"text"`, which is bytes on Python 2 and text on Python 3. Code modules to expect that, avoiding forced text conversions that would break backwards compatibility.
